The impacts associated with the geologic and soil conditions will affect the Community Development Block Grant program in three general ways; housing rehabilitation and code enforcement, capital improvements to street and sewers, and construction or expansion of community facilities. The potential impact on each of these categories is examined by CNRA below.
Alma CNRA:
Housing Rehabilitation
None planned; no impact.
Capital Improvements
None planned; no impacts.
Public Facilities
The Alma Neighborhood Center is proposed for construction in this area with current CDBG funds. The site expected to be used for the Center is outside any fault zone but is in an area of moderate potential for ground failure due to seismic shaking. This hazard is not severe enough to warrant a negative impact, but does necessitate an on-site soils and foundation investigation prior to design and construction of the building.
